renders.title: Remaining time hidden
renders.lua:
A_Admin.SetCasting(635,"Holy Light","Interface\\Icons\\Spell_Holy_HolyBolt",2.5)
local clock = C_DurationUtil.CreateManualClock(1)
local duration = C_DurationUtil.CreateDuration()
duration:SetClock(clock)
duration:SetTimeFromStart(0,2.5)
local reader = UnitCastingDuration
UnitCastingDuration = function(unit) if unit == "player" then return duration end return reader(unit) end
A_Admin.FireEvent("UNIT_SPELLCAST_START","player")
RikRenderCenter(RikUICast_player,2)
for _, option in ipairs(RikUI.CastBars.Options.settings) do if option.key == "timeText" then option.set(false) end end

renders.title: The combat HUD
renders.lua:
RikRenderSpellbook()
RikRenderCooldowns({ { id = 853, duration = 60, elapsed = 19.1 }, { id = 1022, duration = 300, elapsed = 268.1 }, { id = 498, duration = 300, elapsed = 255.1 } })
A_Admin.AddBuff(20287, "Seal of Righteousness", 132325, 30, 0)
assert(RikUI.Layout.ApplyCombatHUD())
RikUI.Cooldowns.Rebuild()
RikUI.UnitFrames.Refresh()
RikUIUnit_petframe:Hide()
A_Admin.SetCasting(635, "Holy Light", "Interface\\Icons\\Spell_Holy_HolyBolt", 2.5)
local clock = C_DurationUtil.CreateManualClock(1)
local duration = C_DurationUtil.CreateDuration()
duration:SetClock(clock)
duration:SetTimeFromStart(0, 2.5)
local reader = UnitCastingDuration
UnitCastingDuration = function(unit) if unit == "player" then return duration end return reader(unit) end
A_Admin.FireEvent("UNIT_SPELLCAST_START", "player")
local realTime = GetTime
local started = realTime()
A_Admin.FireEvent("PLAYER_SWING", 2.4, Enum.PlayerSwingType.MainHand)
GetTime = function() return started + 1 end
local mainHand = RikUI.SwingTimer.Bars[Enum.PlayerSwingType.MainHand]
mainHand:GetScript("OnUpdate")(mainHand, 0)
RikRenderGroup("RikRenderHUD", { RikUICooldowns, RikUICombatResource, RikUICast_player, RikUISwingTimer, RikUIClassAuras_player, RikUIClassAuras_target, RikUIUnit_player, RikUIUnit_target, RikUIUnit_focus }, 470, 240, 830, 340)
RikRenderResize(RikRenderHUD)
renders.assertLua:
local ids = {}
for _, entry in ipairs(RikUI.Cooldowns.Entries) do ids[#ids + 1] = entry.id end
assert(table.concat(ids, ",") == "20287,20271,853,1022,633,498,679", "Unexpected strip order: " .. table.concat(ids, ","))
assert(RikUI.Cooldowns.Buttons[2].icon:GetTexture() == 135959, "Wrong Judgement icon")
assert(not RikUI.Cooldowns.Buttons[3].unknown:IsShown(), "Hammer of Justice cooldown must be readable")
